questions.question: Before the Levites could serve at the Tent of Meeting, what did the LORD tell Moses to do with them?

answers.text: Move them to the camp's edge

questions.question: When did the LORD set apart every firstborn male in Israel for Himself?

answers.text: The day He struck down Egypt's firstborn
The day He parted the Red Sea
The day He gave the Ten Commandments

questions.question: Why did the LORD have the Levites serve at the Tent of Meeting and make atonement for Israel?

answers.text: So no plague would strike Israel near the sanctuary
So the other tribes could skip their offerings
So Israel's army could stay ready for war
